title: Tôi đã bị tính phí cho thứ mà tôi không sử dụng
englishTitle: I was charged for something I did not use
pronunciation: Toi da bi tinh phi cho thu ma toi khong su dung
summary: For questioning a hotel or service charge for something you did not use.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Point to the bill line, room number, booking, minibar item, laundry slip, or service charge before explaining.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Keep the receipt visible. Ask for the line to be checked before arguing about the full bill.

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Tôi đã bị tính phí means I was charged; cho thứ mà tôi không sử dụng means for something I did not use.

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Reservation, check-in, and polite-check-in cards help if the bill issue is tied to your booking.

phrases.english: I’d like to check in, please

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good at hotel checkout, guesthouse desks, tour counters, laundry pickups, and service bills with an extra item.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: If they remove the charge, ask for the new total or updated receipt before paying.

sections.title: Explore next
